questions.question: Write a short note on different types of matrix representation. / [CO4] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Definition and example of incidence Matrix
  • Let G = (V, E) be an undirected graph. Suppose that v1, v2, … , vn are the vertices and e1, e2, … , em are
  • the edges of G. Then the incidence matrix with respect to this ordering of V and E is the n× m matrix M =
  • [mij], wherewhere
  • mij ={1 when edge ej is incident with vi
  • 0 other wise
  • .......5 marks
  • Definition and example of adjacency Matrix
  • Suppose that G = (V, E) is a simple graph where |V| = n. Suppose that the vertices of G are listed
  • arbitrarily as v1, v2, … , vn. The adjacency matrix A (or AG) of G, with respect to this listing of the vertices,
  • is the n x n zero–one matrix with 1 as its (i, j)th entry when vi and vj are adjacent, and 0 as its (i, j)th
  • entry when they are not adjacent. . ........5 marks [U]/[CO4]
